attributes.action: Have free drink and bottle covers available in every bar and restaurant.
attributes.additional_details: This petition calls for every bar and restaurant in the country to provide free drink-spiking test kits and bottle or drink covers to customers. I know and believe these simple safety measures could help prevent drink spiking, increase awareness, and make nights out safer for everyone.
attributes.background:
I’d like to start a petition calling for every bar and restaurant in the country to provide free bottle/drink covers. From personal experience, I believe these simple safety measures should be available to everyone.
It may be beneficial to have drink spiking test kits available also.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Require licensed venues to offer free anti-spiking drink covers to patrons
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/767851
